changelog:
Initial release of Magic Hour skill.

- Generate AI video and images using the Magic Hour API, supporting multiple popular models.
- Features text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation; asynchronous jobs with status polling.
- Free tier available (400 credits on signup plus daily bonus).
- Provides Python scripts and a hosted MCP server for remote, no-install use.
- Full documentation for setup, script usage, model selection, and prompting tips provided in SKILL.md.
summary: Generate AI video and images with the Magic Hour API (Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, WAN 2.2, GPT-image, Nano Banana Pro). Text-to-video, image-to-video, image generation; free tier available.
